# FocusStudy Visual References

## Global direction

Warm, calm, cozy student planner.

Use references for:
- composition
- spacing
- color relationships
- card hierarchy
- icon treatment
- illustration mood

Never copy:
- branding
- characters
- text
- proprietary artwork
